title: About Our Coding Club
subtitle: A collective of visionary student builders, algorithm designers, and software craftspeople.
description: CODEX was founded as an ecosystem where ambitious collegiate developers move beyond conventional classroom theory. We build production-grade web systems, train neural networks, engineer interactive graphics, and collaborate on real-world industry problems.
extendedDescription: Operating under the Department of Information Technology, our club bridges the gap between academic computer science and modern tech industry practices. Through peer mentorship, open-source sprints, and competitive hackathons, we prepare students to lead and innovate on a global scale.
vision: To establish an elite engineering culture where curiosity fuels breakthrough software innovation and every member achieves technical mastery.
mission: Empowering students through hands-on architecture, rigorous code reviews, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and high-impact project execution.

pillars.title: Engineering Rigor
pillars.description: We prioritize clean architecture, performant algorithms, and production-ready deployments.

pillars.title: Community & Mentorship
pillars.description: Senior developers mentor juniors in modern stacks, system design, and interview readiness.

pillars.title: Open Source Culture
pillars.description: Contributing upstream to global projects and publishing developer tools for the community.

pillars.title: Frontier Technologies
pillars.description: Continuous exploration of LLMs, spatial computing, WebGPU, and distributed architectures.
